label: Interior structure and fields
text: EA.O.A2.3 Interior structure and fields. Seismology infers layering from travel times. S waves do not pass through the outer core, which is evidence it is liquid. The geodynamo (the field generated in the liquid outer core) is owned here as an Earth-state claim. The MHD equations used are PH. Geodesy as a claim — figure of the Earth, gravity field — is owned here.

warrant.defeaters: Non-unique inversion; model dependence; sparse coverage
